uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2459-4247-4753.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Clever Impersonator trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Clever Impersonator.
Repeat.

728-5394-6291.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

603-728-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
603-728-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

240-3899-5470-7297.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

3240-5631-6462-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3899-5662--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3899-5662--5--195.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reyhan trigger.
Resolve Reyhan's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Repeat.

277-2557-4094-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-2557-4094-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

301-2376-4738.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

132-5200-7826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Foods.
132-5200-7826.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1753-3899-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7782.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1921-4659-7747.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Giant-Sized Flying Ant token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

250-779-1479-4488-5414.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4488-5414.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4067-5904-6921.easyPrerequisites:
Biorganic Carapace is attached to a creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a mana-producing permanent that can produce {U}.
4067-5904-6921.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four modified creatures.
4067-5904-6921.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Biorganic Carapace attached, triggering it.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying the creature's trigger.
Resolve the copy of the creature's ability, drawing a card for each modified creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Adric.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 5 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
4067-5904-6921.notes: Depending on how many modified creatures you control, you may draw more cards than is needed to continue the loop. You can choose to keep those cards or discard them for additional results.

656-4616-5220.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Ugin's Conjurant from your library, and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

4186-5686-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
4186-5686-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

575-5971-6798.notablePrerequisites: Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-5971-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing it.
When Umbral Collar Zealot dies, Yedora triggers, returning Umbral Collar Zealot from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Umbral Collar Zealot enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning the creature face-up.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1, doing nothing.
Repeat.
575-5971-6798.notes: You may instead sacrifice a different creature to get the infinite sacrifice outlet products.

2921-4215-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a green nontoken creature.
2921-4215-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a green nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature from your library to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1987-3277-4377-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-3277-4377-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

2316-4050-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-4050-4365.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

3152-4182-5570.notablePrerequisites:
Nardole has at least six counters on it.
Nardole does not have summoning sickness.
3152-4182-5570.description:
Activate Nardole by tapping it, adding at least six {U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Nardole.
Resolve Whispers of the Muse, causing you to draw a card and return Whispers of the Muse to your hand.
Repeat.
If Nardole has at least seven counters on it, this combo nets near-infinite {U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells, and you may target any other creature using Chakram Retriever's trigger.

412-618-2816-5313.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Kiki-Jiki.
At least nine cards in your graveyard.
412-618-2816-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Ancestor's Chosen with haste.
The token enters gaining you 9 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

975-1636.notablePrerequisites: Jund Battlemage does not have summoning sickness.
975-1636.description:
Pay {G} and tap Jund Battlemage to create a 1/1 Saproling.
The Saproling enters untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

1517-2104-3637.notablePrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture has two lore counters on it.
1517-2104-3637.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself, sacrificing itself and copying all instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, creating a copy of Temporal Manipulation.
Resolve both Temporal Manipulations, getting two extra turns after this one.
Cast Brought Back by paying {W}{W}.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, copying Brought Back.
Resolve the first Brought Back, failing to return any permanents to the battlefield.
Resolve the second Brought Back, returning The Mirari Conjecture from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself and returning Brought Back from your graveyard to your hand.
Proceed to your next turn.
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself and returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Proceed to your next turn.
Repeat.
